_doc: Body type of each Fight animation, and the depth profile fight_to_vox.py uses for it.
Waist/upper-body slimming (user, 2026-09-14) is for humans and human-shaped creatures only:
humans, orcs, leopard-men, humanoid mechs. Flying, mounted, dragon and other shapes are tuned
separately here. Ids not listed are humanoid. Types were assigned by looking at every
upper = depth kept across the upper body (t 0.35-0.85 of the body height), waist = extra depth
kept at the waist (t 0.5), all = depth kept at every height (default 1.0); 1.0 = no slimming.
flying all 0.5: wings and body inflate as one blob otherwise and read as an egg from the side.
